decisions.reason: The LHD loader line was launched only in 2018 and fits the firm's core underground mining expertise, so its prospects remain uncertain while keeping it on the market costs little given the shared engineering, parts and service base. That makes holding the option open the rational choice.

The underground dump trucks complement the loaders in the same mining fleet offering, and one year on the market reveals too little about their value to justify abandonment. Low incremental holding costs favor keeping the option.
